description: Current USD price and deviation from the $1 peg for USDT, USDC, DAI, FDUSD and PYUSD (CoinGecko public price data). Flags MICRO_DEPEG at 0.15% or more and DEPEG at 1% or more. A single snapshot of CoinGecko's aggregate price: no per-pool Curve imbalance and no redemption-liquidity data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
